name: Gecko Security

soc2_evidence.signal: Privacy policy explicitly states 'We maintain independent attestation of our control environment, including SOC 2 compliance' and references annual third-party audits.
Trust Center hosted at trust.gecko.security referenced on main website.

aws_evidence: Website shows Azure integration logo; no AWS-specific mentions found in public sources.
pitch_note: Disqualified: Gecko Security already has SOC 2 compliance per their own privacy policy and trust center. As an AI security engineering company they are also the wrong ICP — they are a security vendor themselves, not a buyer of compliance services.

name: Roundabout Technologies

soc2_evidence.signal: Government/municipal buyer vertical (city traffic infrastructure) typically requires SOC 2 or equivalent for vendor procurement. No SOC 2 evidence found publicly.
Deploying safety-critical AI systems on public roads for city governments — regulated procurement environment.

aws_evidence: No public cloud/AWS mentions found. Edge/embedded compute likely given real-time traffic signal control use case.
pitch_note: Government/municipal buyer vertical means SOC 2 will likely be required for enterprise contracts, but this is edge/embedded compute (not AWS-native SaaS), team of 5 with no security hiring signals, and the software is not SaaS in the traditional sense. Low-priority lead: wrong stack profile and buyer type for a typical SOC 2 SaaS conversation.

name: Nori

soc2_evidence.signal: Website mentions 'HIPAA-grade encryption' and data encryption in transit and at rest, but no SOC 2 or formal HIPAA certification found.
Consumer health app integrating Apple Health, Oura, Whoop, medical records — PHI exposure means enterprise/B2B sales will require SOC 2.

aws_evidence: No public AWS or cloud infrastructure mentions found in available sources.
pitch_note: Consumer-first health coach handling medical records and wearable data — any B2B or enterprise channel (employer wellness, payer partnerships) will require SOC 2. No SOC 2 found publicly. Founders are serial entrepreneurs (Chartable/Spotify, Octopart/YC). Primary uncertainty: mostly consumer-facing today, so enterprise SOC 2 pressure may not be immediate. Monitor for B2B pivot signals.

name: Kaigo Health

soc2_evidence.signal: Healthcare IT platform handling Medicare patient data (PHI) and coordinating with hospital systems — SOC 2 almost certainly required by health system customers.
No SOC 2 or HIPAA certification found on website or any public source; website only lists contact email founders@kaigohealth.ai.

aws_evidence: No public AWS or cloud infrastructure mentions found. Healthcare AI platforms frequently default to AWS for HIPAA eligibility.
pitch_note: Strong ICP signal: Medicare/outpatient care AI handling sensitive PHI, selling to regulated health system buyers who will demand SOC 2. No SOC 2 found — gap confirmed. Lean team of 3 at YC F25. Pitch: 'Your hospital and payer customers will require SOC 2 before signing — we can get you Type I in 8-12 weeks so you don't lose deals.' Lukas Klaiber is the warmest contact (active on LinkedIn).

name: Casey

soc2_evidence.signal: AI-native commercial insurance brokerage handling sensitive commercial risk data and carrier submissions — insurance carriers typically require SOC 2 from technology vendors.
No SOC 2 certification found on caseyinsure.com or any public source.

aws_evidence: No public AWS or specific cloud infrastructure mentions found. InsurTech startups with ETH Zurich/grape engineering backgrounds often use cloud-native stacks.
pitch_note: Regulated fintech/insurance vertical: commercial insurance carriers and brokers will demand SOC 2 as a table-stakes vendor requirement. No SOC 2 evidence found. Actively raising a $2.5M Seed round — compliance spend is timely. Pitch: 'Carriers won't sign without SOC 2 — we get you Type I before your next carrier onboarding.' Nico Hanggi (CTO) is the primary technical contact via LinkedIn.

name: Play Health

soc2_evidence.signal: Perimenopause care platform handling hormone testing and medical health data for women — any clinical or employer channel will require SOC 2 + HIPAA.
No SOC 2 or HIPAA certification found on playhealth.com (site returned 403). No public compliance documentation found.

aws_evidence: No public AWS or cloud infrastructure mentions found.
pitch_note: Digital women's health platform handling hormone test results and health data — enterprise employer or clinical sales will require SOC 2. No SOC 2 found. Second-time founders with a prior exit (Known Medicine to Pathos AI) understand compliance burden. Pitch angle: 'Employer wellness and clinical partnerships will gate on SOC 2 — get it done before you lose your first enterprise deal.' Andrea Mazzocchi is accessible on both LinkedIn and X.

name: Anto Biosciences

soc2_evidence.signal: Biotech/genomics foundation model company — primary customers are pharma/biotech research orgs which may or may not require SOC 2. No SOC 2 evidence found publicly.

aws_evidence: No public AWS or cloud infrastructure mentions found. Genomics/ML workloads commonly run on cloud GPU clusters (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
pitch_note: Biotech foundation model company selling to pharma/research orgs — SOC 2 need is plausible if they handle genomic/clinical data for enterprise pharma customers, but buyer type (academic/pharma researchers) is not a classic SOC 2-driven procurement environment. Small team, very early stage, wrong primary vertical for this ICP. Low priority — revisit if they pivot toward healthcare IT or enterprise SaaS.

name: Amera

soc2_evidence.signal: Automating claims processing for health insurance payers handling EDI claims, PDFs, and stop-loss reporting — highly regulated, and health plan payers require SOC 2 from all vendors handling their data.
Website references 'Built-in compliance checks' and 'Built for Healthcare' but no SOC 2 or HIPAA certification explicitly stated.
Already working with payers/plan administrators representing ~100k members — enterprise payer contracts will mandate SOC 2.

aws_evidence: Deep Kapur has background in distributed systems and cloud infrastructure per YC profile. Rupa Health (prior employer) is AWS-native. Health insurance claims processing at scale typically runs on AWS for HIPAA eligibility.
pitch_note: Top lead in this slice. Amera processes claims for health insurance payers — one of the most regulated environments possible. Payers representing 100k+ members are already customers; those contracts will mandate SOC 2. No SOC 2 evidence found. Likely AWS-native (founders from Rupa Health, cloud infrastructure background). Lean team of 8 at YC F25. Pitch: 'Your payer customers cannot renew contracts without SOC 2 in place — we can deliver Type I in 8-12 weeks so you protect existing MRR and close the next payer deal.' Deep Kapur (@deepkkapur) is the most reachable founder via X and LinkedIn.
